prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop landing-page UI mockup for BugReceipt, a privacy-first Chrome extension that records a tab, console errors, network activity, and manual QA steps, then lets the user review and export evidence locally. Use the two reference images only for BugReceipt's established visual identity and the real extension interface; do not copy the old page structure and do not use the name ReproKit. Canvas 1536x1024, polished product-design screenshot, credible browser-product marketing page. Direction: FAILURE TRACE TIMELINE. Keep the established colors exactly in spirit: deep ink navy, pale paper/fog blue, thin desaturated blue rules, coral signal accent, teal trace accent. Square geometry, thin technical rules, Bricolage-Grotesque-like display type and compact monospaced labels. Build the page around one continuous diagnostic trace rather than stacked marketing sections. Use a compact navigation, then a bold left-third benefit statement "Turn broken into reproducible." with one primary CTA "Download BugReceipt". A thin teal-and-coral evidence trace should travel horizontally through the first viewport with readable checkpoints and timestamps: 00:00 Record, 00:08 Console, 00:12 Network, 00:18 Review, 00:24 Export. Dock a large, realistic view of the actual BugReceipt extension interface to the active trace event so the product remains the hero. Show the next trace segments continuing below the fold with small evidence excerpts and privacy markers, creating a narrative from failure to handoff. Include the boundary statement "Local until you choose to share." Strong editorial hierarchy and one unmistakable reading path. No generic stepper component, no rounded card grid, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no decorative blobs, no fake testimonials, no pill-heavy UI. All text must be crisp and correctly spelled.
decision: Failure Trace Timeline landing-page redesign approved from the rendered comp.
